gates.title: Package, CLI and discovery -- port the prototype behind a real entrypoint
gates.task: Stand up scripts/code_map/ as the repo's FIRST Python package under scripts/ and move the prototype (astx.py, supplement.py, render_map.py) behind a real CLI with argparse. This is a PORT: no behavior change, no defect fixes, no schema changes -- those are g2/g3/g4. The prototype hardcodes ROOT to an external repo and has no argparse at all, so nothing downstream can run until this exists. Add a discovery layer that enumerates the corpus from git ls-files and EXCLUDES .agent-work/. Add the narrow .gitignore entries for the statement store, supplement and position cache -- .agent-work/ is deliberately TRACKED in this repo so a blanket scratch rule is wrong. Verify the installer's runtime-closure tests still pass: _direct_runtime_siblings resolves siblings as scripts/<name>.py and is blind to a package directory, so confirm this package does not silently fall outside the bundling machinery.
gates.close: python scripts/code_map/cli.py --root <repo> enumerates exactly the 103-file corpus and runs extract->supplement->render end to end; full existing suite still green
constraints: stdlib only -- CI installs pytest and coverage and nothing else
PORT only: any behavior change here is out of scope and belongs to a later gate
the discovery layer MUST exclude .agent-work/ (130 of 233 tracked .py files)

structural: scripts/code_map/ -- new package, the repo's first under scripts/
constraint: the run report carries no timings
decision: package layout vs 42 flat scripts -- RULED by the human; carried to reconcile as a decision candidate because it governs future structure
confidence_flags: installer runtime-closure detector assumes flat scripts/<name>.py and cannot see a package -- verify, do not assume

gates.title: A check stage that can fail
gates.depends: g0 -- there must be a pipeline to check
gates.task: REWRITE the prototype's checks; do not port them. They are print-only today: no assertions, no exit code, so they read as measurements and never as a passing suite. Deliver assertions with nonzero exit and thresholds committed against THIS corpus (103 files / 3,411 entities / 52,292 lines), never the prototype's 1,224-file numbers -- otherwise the first CI run is the experiment. Cover: determinism (rebuild twice, byte-identical, no non-empty diff on unchanged source); referenced-by semantics (count AND module list against an independent source scan); edge recall per predicate with a floor, including `writes` where the independent oracle is blind; hole count against a committed baseline; template-ASCII by exact-line provenance; and the CHURN RATIO with its 3x ceiling (critic TS6's disposition attaches a re-measurement gate to the build queue, because g4/g5/g6 move that number in opposite directions -- this gate owns the threshold, g9 owns the re-run).
gates.close: every falsifier in the issue's testing-pathways table has a test that FAILS when its property is broken, proven by a deliberate mutation; nonzero exit on failure
constraints: thresholds are measured against this repo's corpus and committed, not inherited
a check that cannot go red is not a check -- prove each one fails under mutation

constraint: checks must be able to fail
decision: committed thresholds -- sized to this corpus; durable, every later gate is measured against them
confidence_flags: prototype measurements come from a different repo and do NOT transfer

gates.title: D2 -- nested-definition symbol collision (corrupting data today)
gates.depends: g1 -- the regression must be able to go red before it is fixed
gates.task: The renderer resolves callers through the store's flattened symbol, so a nested and a top-level definition that flatten together MERGE their caller sets and both pages show the union. MEASURED ON THIS REPO: 75 flat-name collisions across 1,848 nested definitions -- tests.test_episode_fields.setUp flattens to one symbol nine times, tests.test_grade_lint.setUp seven times. Write the failing test against that real collision FIRST; it needs no external repo and no fixture. Then give nested definitions a distinct symbol identity and fix the caller resolution.
gates.close: the named collision no longer merges caller sets; the test that reproduced it goes from red to green; all 75 collisions resolve to distinct symbols
constraints: red before green -- the reproducer must be committed failing first

constraint: checks must be able to fail
decision: nested-definition symbol identity -- how a nested def is distinguished from a top-level one that flattens to the same name; durable, every consumer inherits it
evidence: inbound-edge attribution -- any page whose caller set differs from an independent full scan

gates.title: Referenced-by trust fix
gates.task: The name list omits the defining module while the count includes it, and nothing states that the count already excludes definition, import and docstring mentions -- so the map says 3 where grep says 7 and the reader cannot tell which is wrong. Make count and list agree, and state the semantics on the page.
gates.close: count and module list agree on every page; the semantics are stated; a page's caller set matches an independent full scan
constraints: ships on the same line as g2 -- do not re-litigate symbol identity here

constraint: page register is agent-first and aggressively minimal
decision: referenced-by semantics -- what the count includes vs what the list shows

gates.title: Statement-schema merge + declare the line base (D1)
gates.depends: g3 -- do this BEFORE productionizing the supplement, so a stage is removed rather than shipped-to-deprecate
gates.task: Fold kind, signature, span, docstring body, values and decorators into the statement-line schema, and add an extraction-window statement. DECLARE the line base: the store is 0-based today and the schema is silent, which is defect D1. Doing this now REMOVES the separate supplement stage instead of productionizing one that a later gate would deprecate.
gates.close: one schema carries all six fields; the supplement stage is gone, not deprecated; the line base is declared in the schema and asserted by a test; ids.jsonl lines are {id,s} with NO q, exercised by minting two anchors and renaming one (critic TS3)
constraints: removing the stage is the point -- shipping the supplement as its own stage fails this gate

decision: line base -- 0-based vs 1-based, declared not implied; durable, every consumer inherits it

gates.title: Top index second tier

gates.task: 1,233 lines over 1,223 modules is not a routing surface -- the trial agent read 60 lines of it and learned nothing. Add a second tier so the top index routes instead of listing.
gates.close: the top index routes a reader to the right module group without listing every module; measured against this repo's module count
constraints: page register: agent-first, aggressively minimal, template text pure ASCII

constraint: page register is agent-first and aggressively minimal
evidence: redundancy rule -- a page whose non-recoverable lines are a minority

gates.title: Split referenced-by into production vs test callers
gates.depends: g3 -- referenced-by semantics must be trustworthy first
gates.task: De-conflate the zero-inbound src entities: unused and untested look identical today. Split the caller list into production and test callers, and fix the useless 'referenced by: none' line on test pages. Do NOT delete test pages.
gates.close: production and test callers are distinguished on every page; no page shows a bare 'referenced by: none' where test callers exist; test pages still render
constraints: test pages are NOT deleted -- explicit ruling

gates.title: Stale-tag detector
gates.depends: g4 -- needs the span in the schema to hash an anchor body
gates.task: Hash each tag's enclosing entity span at extraction. On rebuild, flag any tag whose anchor body changed while its text did not, in the run report. Without this the design ships the predecessor's failure mode in a smaller box.
gates.close: a tag whose anchor body changed while its text did not is flagged in the run report; proven by a fixture that mutates a body and leaves the tag text alone
constraints: the run report carries no timings, so the determinism diff can cover it

constraint: the run report carries no timings

evidence: authored-layer staleness -- a tag whose anchor body changed while its text did not, going unflagged

gates.title: Small items: BOM, wrapped-docstring split (D3), handoff practice
gates.task: Three small items. (1) BOM-prefixed files are rejected by ast.parse -- THIS REPO HAS ZERO BOM FILES, so a purpose-built fixture under tests/fixtures/ is the only way this check can go red; tests/fixtures/overread_corpus/ is the precedent for a fixture corpus directory. (2) D3 wrapped-docstring render split. (3) Record the handoff practice: name which caller holds the value being plumbed, absolute interpreter paths in verification commands, and cut trial branches from origin/<default> never the local default branch -- an unpushed commit underneath silently widened a PR from 3 files to 179 during the trial. That last lesson was already applied to THIS run's branch, which was cut from origin/main while local main sat 21 commits ahead.
gates.close: a BOM fixture exists and its test goes red without the fix; D3 renders correctly; the practice items are recorded where the next run will read them; AND the churn ratio is RE-MEASURED against g1's 3x ceiling now that g4/g5/g6 have moved it (critic TS6's required re-measurement gate)
constraints: the BOM fixture is REQUIRED -- there is no BOM file in this repo to exercise

decision: branch-base practice -- cut from origin/<default>, already applied to this run
